definitions: Any of a family of giants in Greek mythology, born of Uranus and Gaea and ruling the earth until overthrown by the Olympian gods.
The largest moon of the planet Saturn, and the second-largest moon in the Solar System.
A person or thing of very great strength, intellect, or importance.
examples: The Titans were eventually defeated by Zeus.
Titan is the only moon known to have a dense atmosphere.
He was a titan of industry.
